title: Record real test results in handoffs
description: Handoffs currently hardcode tests_run: false. Run the project test command (npm test) during handoff, or accept a --tests-run/--tests-passed flag, and record the actual result in the handoff frontmatter so downstream agents and ready can trust it.
acceptance_criteria: handoff frontmatter reflects whether tests were actually run and their outcome
ready surfaces a failure or warning when the latest handoff reports failing or skipped tests
schema for handoff updated if new fields are added, with example kept in sync
